title: Q6
description:
Read: Exo 17:1-7, Num 20:2-13

They asked whether God was among them. On the later day of the same name, the leader himself is refused the land.

a) What was being tested: his ability to give water, or whether he was among them?

b) The same name falls on a later day and the leader falls with it. What does that add to a heart that always goes astray?
